scientific_limitations: Only the complete-bipartite unweighted full-column Euclidean Laplacian representation is analyzed.

All-dimensional proof is mathematical; 44 small direct determinant tests and six larger finite scans are diagnostic only.
Unindexed equivalent historical work and missing independent audit remain possible.
title: Sharp asymptotic isoperimetric imbalance of complete-bipartite Laplacian simplices
